messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: spike in 5xx rate for eu-west canary group. alert_id=INC-20260315-42. metric: /v1/generate 5xx_rate 12% (baseline 1.2%). detected 2m ago. suspected cause: traffic split applied during blue->green rollout. paging @sanjay-oncall

sanjay: on it, joining. starting quick triage. which customers hit? any dedicated pools?

mira: I see errors in the edge logs, repeated 502s from reverse-proxy to green pool. DNS looks ok for blue, but green endpoints return connection reset from runtime.

leah: rollback flag not yet toggled. Canary feature-flag is "eu_canary_route_v2". I can flip to 0 (kill-switch) but want to confirm blast radius.

jorge: ETA for kill-switch flip is ~30s once confirmed. If we flip, traffic should go back to blue. Also we can reduce canary percentage via traffic-manager: `trafficctl set-split eu-west 100/0`

ops-bot: Observability note: latency up 40%, error budget burn increasing. Affected customers: 5 active sessions from reserved pools, 18 public-api requests failing in last 5m. No major SOC alerts yet.

sanjay: quick customer-impact check: Ops dashboard shows three Dedicated customers seeing 503s (acct ids redacted). CS alerted. Prioritize kill-switch + rollback if green pool not healthy.

mira: checking green runtime pods: `kubectl -n eu-west get pods -l app=runtime,version=green` -> several pods in CrashLoopBackOff with logs showing TLS handshake failures to kvcache-service.

leah: that points to a config mismatch (new runtime built expecting v2 KV service certs). Did the canary include k/v client changes?

jorge: yes, green image included updated KV client that expects cert fingerprint X. The rollout should have had a secret update step, maybe it didn't reach eu-west.

sanjay: decision: flip flag and shift traffic immediately, then rollback green images from canary group. leah, please flip the feature flag now and confirm.

leah: flipping flag now. `ld-ctl toggle eu_canary_route_v2 off --env=prod --region=eu-west`

leah: done. Confirming traffic change. `trafficctl get-split eu-west` -> `blue: 100% | green: 0%`

ops-bot: Metrics: 5xx rate dropping from 12% -> 1.5% over 45s. Latency normalizing. Starting incident timeline for postmortem.

mira: green pods still crash, but less impact now since no traffic. I'll start roll-forward: redeploy green with old KV client or coordinate secret rollout.

jorge: I'll create a quick rollback image tag and push. Using tag `runtime:green-rollback-20260315`. Deploy plan: rolling update scaled to 0 then back to 2 to confirm readiness.

sanjay: good. CS update drafted: "We've mitigated a canary-related routing issue in eu-west by reverting traffic to the stable pool. A small subset of customers experienced intermittent 5xx responses for ~8 minutes. Engineering is rolling back the canary and will follow up with root cause and timeline." Ping once CS sends to affected customers.

leah: CS notified. message queued to 3 customers + status page update.

ops-bot: Incident severity: Sev2 (service degradation for subset of customers). Total affected requests ~320 in 7m window. No data loss.

mira: redeploy started: `kubectl -n eu-west set image deploy/runtime runtime=runtime:green-rollback-20260315` -> rollout status shows new pods stable. Healthchecks pass.

jorge: once green is healthy with old KV client, we can re-run secret rollout and try a smaller canary next window.

sanjay: handoff: I'm going offline in 10m. @mira you'll be primary for follow-up and RCA. Please include action items: (1) ensure config/secret sync for eu-west, (2) add pre-rollout cert check in rollout job, (3) improve canary runbook to include immediate kill-switch steps.

mira: will own RCA. creating incident doc and ticket INC-20260315-42 in phabricator.

leah: quick note for on-call runbook: add `trafficctl set-split` and `ld-ctl toggle` commands to the short-circuit section. Also add verification snippet: `curl -I https://eu-west-api.redwood.ai/v1/health`

ops-bot: Timeline summary: 1887654321 - alert triggered; 1887654362 - kill-switch flipped; 1887654430 - traffic fully on blue; 1887654600 - rollback image deployed; 1887654795 - green pods confirmed healthy. Total incident duration: ~7.5m.

sanjay: thanks team. Mira, please update this thread with RCA link and P0 checklist items. I'll flag for postmortem review next week. Passing oncall to @mira. :white_check_mark:
